title: Concept: Neo4j Browser console is reachable without authentication
description: Neo4j Browser is a Cypher console, not a read-only viewer. When it is reachable and its auth is disabled, the caller writes to the graph directly, and the connect form can be pointed at another instance to use the browser as a relay.
applicability: Responses that serve an administrative or diagnostic interface from a host reachable by ordinary users.
risk: The caller runs arbitrary Cypher against the graph, including writes, and can enumerate the whole dataset the application models.
